clips.text: Here is what Pixel Reel keeps, in plain words. It won't take long, because it isn't much.
It keeps your reel. That is the scenes Claude sends, the recordings of my voice, and the video, if you ask for one.
It keeps nothing about you. There are no accounts, so there are no names, and no email addresses.
One small thing. To stop anyone making too many reels, it counts requests by internet address. That count is never written down, and it is gone within a day.
Reels are deleted after thirty days. Or ask Claude to delete one, and it is gone at once.
Anyone with the link can watch a reel. Links are long and random, so nobody can guess one. But do mind who you send it to.
And the voice is made by Pixel Reel itself. Your words are not sent to a voice company.
